root_cause: Production release stamping required Netlify COMMIT_REF and DEPLOY_ID; when COMMIT_REF is absent, native Git checkout HEAD was not considered even if valid. Netlify production build aborted with PRODUCTION_RELEASE_IDENTITY_UNAVAILABLE.
prevention_rule: Resolve release SHA from verified checkout Git HEAD when COMMIT_REF absent; reject malformed provided SHA and supplied SHA vs checkout mismatch; preserve fail-closed production CONTEXT and DEPLOY_ID; verify published release.json against original main SHA before claiming live.
outcome: PR candidate only; protected CI, merge, Netlify build and independent production readback outstanding.
